verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm that sells legal advisory services, so being driven through a documented public API is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships an API: its AI/ML legaltech is described as internal tooling used in its own practice. The 404 on llms.txt says nothing about an API either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
